answer: Bind each agent to the live mains-frequency signal it samples: the grid's tiny frequency wobble, carried on the copper feeders strung between cedar utility poles, is shared by every device on one electrical branch and drifts unpredictably. N clones on one machine or building return the same electrical-network-frequency fingerprint and collapse into a single admitted identity; forging N independent regional traces requires N real physical locations on separate feeders, so a sybil swarm cannot cheaply manufacture distinct grid signatures.
